title: Half-open integer interval set
description: Implement class IntervalSet holding a set of integers as half-open ranges [start, end). Methods: add(start, end), remove(start, end), contains(x), total(), intervals(). add and remove require ints (bool rejected, TypeError) with start <= end (else ValueError); start == end is a no-op. add merges overlapping AND touching ranges ([1,3) plus [3,5) becomes [1,5)). remove cuts ranges and may split one range in two. intervals() returns a new sorted list of (start, end) tuples that is normalised (no empty, overlapping or touching ranges); mutating the returned list must not change the set. contains(x) is True when start <= x < end for some range (x must be an int, bool rejected, else TypeError). total() is the count of integers covered. add and remove return None. Negative numbers are allowed.
invariants: Touching ranges merge: add(1,3) then add(3,5) gives [(1, 5)].
A bridging add merges every range it touches: ranges [1,2),[4,5),[7,8) plus add(2,7) give [(1, 8)].
remove can split: [1,10) minus [4,6) gives [(1, 4), (6, 10)]; removing a touching range changes nothing.
Ranges are half-open: contains(end) is False, contains(start) is True.
intervals() returns a copy; start > end raises ValueError; non-int or bool raises TypeError.
